claims.statement: The eruption of Vesuvius buried Pompeii and Herculaneum in 79 CE. Their remains preserve buildings, objects and traces of work and domestic life. The linked entries explore some of that evidence, alongside people living elsewhere at the time.
Vesuvius buries Pompeii and Herculaneum: 79 CE to 79 CE. Year-level event. No exact day or month is adopted. The map locates Pompeii as one affected city, not the volcano or the full disaster area.
UNESCO Pompeii city-site reference; not a shop coordinate or volcanic vent.
